expirationMonth.description: Two-digit number representing the card’s expiration month.

expirationYear.description: Four-digit number representing the card’s expiration year.

referenceId.description: A unique string to reference the Payment Link. This can be a cart ID, order ID, or similar, and can be used to reconcile the Payment Link with your internal systems.

afterCompletionUrl.description: If specified, the success page is not shown at the end of a payment, but customer is redirected to this url.

customResultMessage.description: If specified and if `AfterCompletionUrl` is empty, the following message will be displayed upon successful payments. Otherwise, a default message is shown.

name.description: A name given by merchant to identify this Payment Link in the Dashboard.

maxNoOfSuccessPayments.description: If not null, is the maximum number of payments that can be accepted.

language.description: The language of Voucherly Checkout page.

country.description: The country of the purchase. If different from Italy, voucher payment gateways are not shown.

isAutoConfirm.description: Enable or disable auto confirm. If you don't specify anything the default Merchant configuration will be used. When auto confirm is enabled, payment is automatically confirmed before redirecting customer to RedirectSuccessUrl. When auto confirm is disabled, payment requires manual confirmation.

metadata.description: Generic field that can be used to store generic info. It can contain up to 10 key-value items with a maximum length of 40 for the key and of 400 chars for the value.

foodAmount.description: The payable amount with vouchers. Must be lower than `TotalAmount` and no `Lines` must have been spcified.

totalAmount.description: The total payable amount, not considering `Discounts`. No `Lines` must have been spcified.

quantity.description: The number of units of this article.

unitAmount.description: Amount of the single unit of this article.

unitDiscountAmount.description: Discount amount on the unit amount.

discountAmount.description: Total discount amount on this product line.

productName.description: Product name to show to the customer in the checkout.

productImage.description: Product image to show to the customer in the checkout.

isFood.description: Indicates whether this payment line can be purchased with vouchers.

timeout.description: Timeout in minutes for the checkout sessions. Default is 10.

customerId.description: The ID of the customer of this Payment. If empty a new customer will be created.

customerPaymentMethodId.description: ID of the Customer payment method to attach to this Payment.

isPartialPayment.description: Enable or disable partial payments. When partial payment is enabled, customers have the flexibility to pay a portion of the total amount. Customers can decide to use alternative payment methods to cover the remaining amount. When partial payment is disabled, customers are required to pay the entire amount using a combination of payment gateways.

Enable or disable auto confirm.
If you don't specify anything the default Merchant configuration will be used.
When auto confirm is enabled, payment is automatically confirmed before redirecting customer to RedirectSuccessUrl.
When auto confirm is disabled, payment requires manual confirmation.

selectedPaymentGateway.description: Default PaymentGateway used for the first transaction

paymentGateways.description: List of PaymentGateways enabled for this Payment. If empty all PaymentGateways are used.

redirectOkUrl.description: The URL to which Voucherly should send customers when payment is complete.

redirectKoUrl.description: The URL to which Voucherly should send customers when payment is cancelled or failed.

index.description: Specify the order of application of this discount with respect to the others.
